body:
The resizing the window to 0-width/height is fixed by https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/1409, however minimizing the window still causes a crash on Windows, caused by requesting a 0-width/height texture.

Looks like this can be fixed by this comment I left a while back: https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/170#issuecomment-780186140. I can look at creating a PR with those changes.
